QuestInfo.name: Way of the Fox
QuestInfo.0: Silver has something to tell you. Maybe he knows that Moonbeam gave you her spirit. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Silver suggests you take the test to be officially acknowledged as a fox. You don't really have the desire to be acknowledged as a fox, but you should take the test, at least for Moonbeam.
QuestInfo.2: You went through the five tests that the town foxes had for you, and are now recognized as an honorary fox. It wouldn't have been possible without Moonbeam's spirit.
QuestInfo.demandSummary:
Timber's Paw Stamp
Compass's Paw Stamp
Patience's Paw Stamp
Brook's Paw Stamp
Moonbeam's Paw Stamp

0.0: I hear that Moonbeam gave you something special. I had a feeling she wanted to look after you. She gets very attached to certain people, probably because she lost her parents so young. Please do take care of her as well.
0.1: I think it is time for you to take the test. Well, I call it a test, but it's more like a coming-of-age ceremony. Passing this test will give you the right to take part in town meetings, lucky you! You'll be acknowledged as a true fox, too. What do you think? Do you want to take the test?

yes.0: Very well. Every member of the town will have a different part of the test for you to take. Get five paw stamps and then return to me. Start with #r#p3002007##k.

no.0: My apologies. I didn't mean to burden you so quickly. You know, #p3002001# hasn't passed the test yet either...

1.0: Did you get all the paw stamps?

yes.0: Splendid! You passed all the tests. From now on, I, #p3002005#, Chief of Fox Point Village, hereby declare you a true fox, one of our kin. Accept my paw stamp as proof!  \r\n                                                       #fUI/DialogImage.img/quest/0

default.0: Get me five paw stamps, and you will at last be an honorary fox.
